title: Happy, Horny, Hazy (F4NB (My Enby))
description: Three loops for my sweet listeners, deserving of reward, and in each I'll treat you the way you need this the most, through carefully chosen praise to help you feel safe, secure, and so very wonderfully seen. Until those other thoughts which I weave, of a happier, hornier, and hazier kind, cover and cloud over your willing mind. Good Enby. Sweet Enby. You are doing so good. Just relax. Let my words gift my wonderful reward, finding bliss in all the pleasurable tingles my voice brings to you. My perfect pet. These words you've earned from me, washing over you, as you lay back and enjoy it. Feeling so good, knowing you have earned this. Bless you... My Sweet Enby. My one and only. I need you ~ I need you to see what happens when you're a good hypnotic subject.
author: Mistress Shibby
